testingMethodology.approach: Re-run (round 4) targeting failed assertion VAL-FLR-007 only. The fix (commit bfcf2b8) changed handleStartValidation to read proxy settings directly from localStorage via getLiveProxySettings() instead of relying on stale React state from useSettings() hook. Browser automation via agent-browser to verify the fix works in the normal user flow (Settings > enable proxy > navigate to validation > Start) WITHOUT a page reload.

fixes.description: Replaced React state check with direct localStorage read in handleStartValidation. Added getLiveProxySettings() function that reads from 'proxy-settings' and 'app-settings' localStorage keys.
fixes.result: Fix confirmed working. Warning toast now appears correctly without page reload.
